# Gothwad Tech — Public Information Hub

> This English-language website is the public company-information and source-discovery hub for Gothwad Tech. It is distinct from GothwadTech.com, the product/app portal. Developer documentation is maintained separately at docs.gothwadtech.com and is linked rather than duplicated here.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://gothwadtech.github.io/): Company overview, selected projects and confirmed leadership
- [Products](https://gothwadtech.github.io/products/): 26 public ecosystem records, source links, search/filter and listing-only comparison
- [Find a product](https://gothwadtech.github.io/find-a-product/): Browser-only goal/platform filter
- [Product ecosystem map](https://gothwadtech.github.io/integrations/): Portfolio relationships; not a verified integration matrix
- [Repositories](https://gothwadtech.github.io/repositories/): Dated snapshot of 54 public GitHub repositories and licence metadata
- [Leadership](https://gothwadtech.github.io/leadership/): Pawan Gothwad (Founder), Yuvkesh Meena (CEO), Vishnu (Co-founder)
- [About](https://gothwadtech.github.io/about/): Company context and site boundaries
- [Direction](https://gothwadtech.github.io/roadmap/): Non-dated themes, not launch commitments
- [FAQ](https://gothwadtech.github.io/faq/): Public information and project-source guidance
- [Contribute](https://gothwadtech.github.io/contribute/): Routes to project sources and separate docs
- [Site map](https://gothwadtech.github.io/site-map/): Internal pages and product references

## Separate official destinations
- [GothwadTech.com](https://gothwadtech.com/): Product and app discovery portal
- [Developer docs](https://docs.gothwadtech.com/): Separate technical documentation portal
- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/GothwadTech): Current public source repositories
- [CEO profile](https://ceo.gothwadtech.com/)
- [Co-founder profile](https://cofounder.gothwadtech.com/)

## Accuracy

Repository counts, licence labels and portal records are snapshots reviewed on 31 October 2026. Project scope, releases, licences, policies, support and runtime availability vary. A public repository or URL does not prove that a product is released, available, production-ready, supported or licensed for unrestricted reuse. Unknown information is labeled unpublished rather than guessed. This site is English-only and embeds no third-party analytics.
